description: The client’s orders and everything known about them, at once; a single one with its number. Each order returns where it stands (`ou_elle_en_est`), the warehouse photos and the inspection video when there are some, the carrier when it is certain (otherwise the type of `ligne`), the tracking number and the link to track the parcel on 17TRACK: no need to call track_parcel or warehouse_photos. When `anomalie` is true, call warehouse_photos for that order. An order placed on 1688 returns the `produit` reference of its product: to buy the same thing again, call get_quote or order_link with it. When the delivery of a weighed batch is waiting to be paid, the order returns the link to pay it: give it to them.

order_id.description: Order number for a single order (optional). Accepts the number shown in `ref`.

status_filter.description: Filter by status: pending, paid, shipped, delivered, issue, refunded (optional)

name: my_orders
title: My orders
